data.title: Feature Matrix
data.description: The matrix to test, from the selected combined dataset. Sample variables are read from its samples.csv.

matrix.title: Matrix
matrix.description: Path of the matrix within the dataset: <modality>/raw.csv or <modality>/prepared.csv

values.title: Values
values.description: Raw counts are tested with DESeq2. Log-scale values, such as log intensities or log-CPM, are tested with limma. With repeated measures, both are tested with dream.

study_design.title: Study Design
study_design.description: Variables are named by their column in samples.csv. Samples missing a value for any of them are left out.

variable.title: Variable Column
variable.description: Column holding the groups to compare

reference.title: Reference Value
reference.description: Group the target is compared to; features higher in the target have positive fold changes

covariates.title: Covariates (optional)
covariates.description: Comma-separated columns to adjust for, such as age or batch

random_effect.title: Repeated Measures (optional)
random_effect.description: Column naming the unit measured more than once, such as subject_id. Fits a mixed model with dream, with a random intercept for each unit.
